root_cause: Repository-to-production drift: GitHub main carried the old life-only personal prepublish reviewer while the active Supabase Edge v26 already had the richer verified founder builder gate. A naive main-based patch would downgrade production. Independently, the 2026-10-09 personal LinkedIn provider-created share URN could not be read back with connected Composio accounts (403/401).
change: Backport the existing deployed Supabase Edge v26 source to the canonical GitHub repository exactly; preserve the already deployed founder/technical-jargon/security gates and provide regression/learning/docs/ledger in the same release lineage. Provider readback 403 remains a separate unproven obligation.
prevention: Compare canonical GitHub source against actual deployed Supabase Edge source before proposing publisher/prepublish changes; fail closed on drift.
Backport proven production code rather than overwriting it with an older repository implementation.
Run regression checks for founder provenance, non-sales, technical jargon, personal/observational modes, immutable text hash and privacy.
Record the LinkedIn post URN independently of GET_POST_CONTENT; a 403/401 is not permission to republish or claim provider readback.
Keep 8-stage Heartbeat, Brain and Powerhouse loop assurance truthful until external provider and outcome evidence exists.
